scientific_integrity: The continuity classification follows analytically from the source definition, continuity of one-qubit entropy, and the algebraic geometry of fixed-bipartition product states. The sharp jumps are proved by exact entropy bounds and explicit biseparable witnesses.
scientific_limitations: Pure qubit states with at least three parties only; continuity of the literal piecewise Eq. (9) functional. No mixed-state extension or claim that discontinuity alone contradicts LOCC monotonicity. A later comparison paper was identified by indexed metadata but its full text was not accessible in this check.
title: Complete continuity locus and sharp boundary jumps of the Pan–Liu–Lu–Draayer multipartite entropy measure
